leftEvidence.title: Abraham’s faith is counted as righteousness

points.label: Promise and chronology
points.left: Abraham’s faith is counted as righteousness. Romans 4:1–8 belongs to Gospel, Israel, and shared life.
points.right: Receiving the Spirit leads back to Abraham’s faith. Galatians 3:1–9 belongs to Freedom, unity, and imprisonment letters.

points.label: Faith and descendants
points.left: Abraham’s faith is counted as righteousness.
points.right: Receiving the Spirit leads back to Abraham’s faith. Foolish Galatians, who has bewitched you not to obey the truth, before whose eyes Jesus Christ was openly portrayed among you as crucified? So then, those who are of faith are blessed with the faithful Abraham.

payload.posture: Inspect what each source actually says before relating their chronology, argument, or remembered scene.
